summary: Phase 2 (Periode Penilaian & Komponen Observasi PJOK) end-to-end tested. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py with 22 new tests covering CRUD + RBAC + uniqueness + activate flow + nonaktif-hidden-from-guru + seed verification, plus re-ran 34 Phase 1 regression tests. All 56 pytest cases pass (100%). Playwright UI smoke covered admin sidebar (12 menus, 3 section headers), 5 new admin pages (Tahun Ajaran, Semester, Periode Penilaian, Komponen Observasi, Aspek Penilaian), active-period-banner, dashboard active-period-badge for admin + guru, and guru read-only views (active-period-card, category cards with skor 1-4 reference, add buttons properly hidden). No admin-only menus leak to guru sidebar. 18 seeded aspects (5 Persiapan + 8 Pelaksanaan + 5 Penilaian) render correctly. Active period 'Semester Genap 2025/2026' is correctly surfaced everywhere.

minor.issue: Spec says missing/invalid category_id should return 404; impl returns 400. Tests accept both. Documentation alignment only.

action_items: (Optional) Align observation-aspects category_id validation to return 404 per spec instead of 400, or update spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1190+ lines - consider splitting into routers (auth, users, master-data, periode, observasi) for maintainability.
audit() helper writes to db.audit_logs but no API exposes audit log retrieval - acceptable for now but plan retrieval endpoint for audit trail UI.
RBAC checks repeated inline in many endpoints; consider FastAPI dependency `require_role('admin')` to DRY up.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all required Phase 2 testids verified, read-only role-aware views correct)

seed_data_creation: No new seed needed. Verified existing Phase 2 seed: 1 academic year (2025/2026), 2 semesters (Ganjil, Genap), 1 active period (Semester Genap 2025/2026), 3 categories (Persiapan/Pelaksanaan/Penilaian), 18 aspects (5+8+5).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 (34 tests) + Phase 2 (22 tests) backend regression in /app/backend/tests/. Login redirects to '/' not '/dashboard' (root component IS the dashboard). Login page testids use 'login-' prefix (login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-button). Sidebar guru-profile testid is 'menu-profile' (not menu-profil as agent note suggested). For UI tests, prefer waiting for 'active-period-badge' as post-login indicator. Activate flow needs at least 2 periods to demonstrate auto-deactivation in UI; currently only 1 period seeded so activate-* buttons are 0 (validated via API test_create_period_uniqueness_and_activation instead).
rca_notes: Two cosmetic mismatches found between request testids and implementation: (1) request mentioned 'menu-profil' but actual testid is 'menu-profile' (works fine). (2) spec said category_id invalid -> 404 but server returns 400 (semantically equivalent, both validation failures). Neither is a functional bug.
